select sku.id, sku.item_id, sku.sku_name, sku.barcode, sku.sku_code, sku.spec_model, sku.default_unit_price, sku.default_quality_grade, sku.status, sku.volume, sku.length, sku.width, sku.height, sku.gross_weight, sku.net_weight, sku.cost_price, sku.selling_price, sku.create_by, sku.create_time, sku.update_by, sku.update_time, item.id as item_id_ref, item.item_code, item.item_name, item.item_category, item.unit as item_unit, item.item_brand, item.item_type, item.tracking_mode, item.allow_box, item.spec_level, item.equipment_name, item.equipment_type, item.status as item_status, item.default_tracking_mode, item.default_belong_unit, item.default_quality_grade as item_default_quality_grade, item.product_mark_rule, item.model_text, item.remark as item_remark from wms_item_sku sku inner join wms_item item on sku.item_id=item.id inner join wms_item_category category on item.item_category=category.id
and item.item_name like concat('%', #{bo.itemName}, '%')
and item.item_code like concat('%', #{bo.itemCode}, '%')
and item.equipment_name like concat('%', #{bo.equipmentName}, '%')
and item.item_brand=#{bo.itemBrand}
and sku.sku_name like concat('%', #{bo.skuName}, '%')
and sku.barcode like concat('%', #{bo.barcode}, '%')
and sku.spec_model like concat('%', #{bo.specModel}, '%')
and (category.id=#{bo.itemCategory} or category.parent_id=#{bo.itemCategory})
order by sku.item_id desc
